pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients along the edges. The patches exhibit moderate eccentricity and are distributed with relatively uniform spatial density across the visible flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes typically link three to four pathways. Pixel thickness of the pathways is variable, with some areas exhibiting reduced contrast due to image blur.
